description:
About Judi Health 

 Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit www.judi.health .

 Location: Hybrid 3 days in office (New York, NY, Denver, CO or Charlotte, NC area)

 About the team 

 The Platform team at Judi Health is made up of passionate, motivated, and driven individuals who are experts in technology and dedicated problem solvers. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and urgency, delivering high-quality solutions that ensure seamless operations and foster collaboration across the engineering organization. The team owns the architecture, standards, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines that development teams rely on to deliver code to the Judi® platform. We are also responsible for supporting production environments through monitoring, alerting, and operational best practices, while providing both enterprise-wide solutions and guidance to product teams.

 Position Summary: 

 Judi Health is building the technology infrastructure our nation needs to deliver the healthcare we deserve. The Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for driving the adoption of world class reliability practices across the organization, ensuring the best possible experience for the lives we provide care for.

 As a Platform Developer, SRE, you will be working with our internal teams to fine tune customer driven monitoring, alerting, and iterative feedback loops to increase reliability across the entire engineering organization.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 
 Work with internal development teams to distill customer facing metrics

 Assist internal development teams with crafting monitoring and alerting based on customer driven metrics

 Write terraform modules that assist in the onboarding of internal teams to our monitoring and alerting platform

 Help drive the adoption of world class site reliability principles and practices across the organization

 Adopt Agile/Scrum methodologies, actively participating in planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 Experience supporting 24/7 production on-call rotations, including responding to alerts and resolving incidents outside of standard business hours

 Experience in automating Observability & Monitoring (Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus), standardizing incident response for alerts to maintain SLAs and SLOs

 Proficiency in Terraform, or similar IaC tooling

 Practical experience within a cloud provider and its component services (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc)

 Some experience in python, or bash scripting

 Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers, IT security & compliance, product managers, and scrum masters.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you will help produce guidance that the broader engineering organization depends on

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 Experience in customer facing support roles, quality assurance

 Experience with Docker and container orchestration

 Background in healthcare, pharmacy, financial services, or other regulated domains where data pipelines carry audit and correctness obligations

 New York, NY Salary Range
 $108,800 — $136,000 USD 

 Denver, CO Salary Range
 $100,000 — $125,000 USD 

 Charlotte, NC Salary Range
 $92,000 — $113,500 USD 


 All employees are responsible for adherence to the Judi Health Code of Conduct including the reporting of non-compliance. This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals. 

 We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, medical condition, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.   

 By submitting an application, you agree to the retention of your personal data for consideration for a future position at Judi Health. More details about Judi Health's privacy practices can be found at   https://www.judi.health/legal/privacy-policy .
